data.sections.canbuild: List of unit identifiers this unit can create. Can be buildings or units.
data.sections.canbuild.addresources: Adds these resources to self when placing the building or producing the unit.
data.sections.canbuild.extralaghidinginu: Used in multiplayer games to immediately update in the UI without waiting for confirmation from the server.
data.sections.canbuild.forcenano: Builds target as if it was a building if true. (even if it's a unit)
data.sections.canbuild.isguiblinking: Generates a blinking effect in UI if true.
data.sections.canbuild.islocked: Dynamically locks this build option and shows isLockedMessage if true.

data.sections.canbuild.islockedalt2: Like isLockedAlt but to show one more message.
data.sections.canbuild.islockedmessage: Set to tell to players why a unit is locked.

data.sections.canbuild.isvisible: Hide this build link if true in this unit UI.
data.sections.canbuild.name: List of unit identifiers this unit can create. Can be buildings or units. Add "setRally" to create a rally button
data.sections.canbuild.pos: Order build link appears in this unit UI.
data.sections.canbuild.price: Overrides builded units/buildings price. Defaults to target unit prices.
data.sections.canbuild.tech: Tech level. Mostly just affects build link colour in this unit UI. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.canbuild.type: Same usage as displayType in action section
data.sections.comment: Used exclusively for notes, does not read anything
data.sections.core: Core unit functions such as HP and death animation
data.sections.core.altNames: Comma separated list of names. Like name but lower priority, useful for multiple optional mods.
data.sections.core.buildSpeed: Time it takes to build the unit. (may multiply with builder speed)
data.sections.core.class: Reserved for future use, must be CustomUnitMetadata by default. Is not necessary to include, has no additional functions.
data.sections.core.isBio: Choose whether the unit is bioligical or not, affects sound and splat (unless hideScorchMark:true)
data.sections.core.isBug: Changes some death defaults, and sort order in Sandbox.
data.sections.core.isBuilder: Normally required if this unit places buildings. Defaults to [ai]useAsBuilder.
data.sections.core.mass: The 'weight' of the unit, defines how it collides with other units, a greater value means it's tougher to push.
data.sections.core.maxHp: The max health for the unit. (will spawn with this value).
data.sections.core.maxShield: The max shield hitpoints of the unit. Can start with 0 hitpoints if startShieldAtZero:true.
data.sections.core.name: Defines the unit raw name, game uses it to identify as a unique name. (This is not displayed in-game)
data.sections.core.price: The unit cost from builders/buildings. Defaults to credits if no resource type is used
data.sections.core.radius: Circular area around the unit that makes it selectable. (mouse click/screen touch)
data.sections.core.startShieldAtZero: Unit starts with a 0 hitpoints shield on created if true.
data.sections.core.streamingCost: Like price but paid for overtime while this unit is being queued or built. Construction or queue is paused if resources run out while building.
data.sections.core.strictLevel: Defaults to 0. 1 = Errors if keys are duplicated. Add to "all-units.template" in root to apply to all units.
data.sections.core.switchPriceWithStream: Shortcut to set streamingCost to price value and clear price, add to all-units.template to quickly switch a mod over to streaming resources.
data.sections.core.techLevel: Defines the Tech Level of the unit, there're 3 levels and each will appear in a different color in the GUI.
data.sections.decal: Versatile graphics can be stack to make 2.5D sprites
data.sections.effect: Visual effects spawned by unit that eventually disappear
data.sections.global_resource: Global resource collected by team shows up on top
data.sections.graphics: Main image configuration and unit trails
data.sections.graphics.animation_directi: Animation frames to offset on direction change.
Animation frames to offset on direction change. Used with frame_height.
45 for 8 directions, 90 for 4 direction animation. Used with rotate_with_direction:false
data.sections.graphics.animation_type_en: End frame, must be larger then start
data.sections.graphics.animation_type_pi: Play animation in reverse before repeating. Useful with scale_start/scale_end
data.sections.graphics.animation_type_sc: Scale unit image. Defaults to 1. Useful for bio units or breathing effects.
Scale unit image. Defaults to 1. Useful for bio units or breathing effects.
data.sections.graphics.animation_type_sp: Delay for each frame of animation. Larger values cause slower animation
data.sections.graphics.animation_type_st: TYPE can be set to: attack, moving, idle. Use [animation] section instead for more control
data.sections.graphics.default_frame: Default frame when not playing an animation. First frame is 0
data.sections.graphics.disablelowhpfire: Defaults to false. When true, removes the flames on severely damaged unit/structure.
data.sections.graphics.disablelowhpsmoke: Defaults to false. When true, removes the smokes on severely damaged unit/structure.
data.sections.graphics.drawlayer: Land units normally default to ground or ground2 if transport. Options: wreaks, underwater, bottom, ground, ground2, experimentals, air, top
data.sections.graphics.dusteffect: True to create a dust effect when over land. Default false
data.sections.graphics.dusteffectreverse: True to also create effect when unit is reversing
data.sections.graphics.frame_width: Calculated for you if total frames is set, but can be overridden
data.sections.graphics.icon_build: Displays icon of the unit on Build Panel
data.sections.graphics.icon_zoomed_out: Sets the custom image of the unit icon on the zoomed out battle map
data.sections.graphics.icon_zoomed_out_n: Sets wheather show the unit icon or not on the zoomed out battle map
data.sections.graphics.image_back: An optional image drawn behind other units. Useful for factories that units exit
data.sections.graphics.image_floatingpoi: Fixes of by 1 pixel sizing for images with widths and/or height that has odd value
data.sections.graphics.image_offseth: Use this to adjust the height of the graphic, especially when using decals
data.sections.graphics.image_offsetx: Use this to adjust the graphics of a unit if it is too far off one side
data.sections.graphics.image_offsety: Use this to adjust the graphics of a unit if it is too far off one side
data.sections.graphics.image_shadow: Image file, NONE, AUTO or AUTO_ANIMATED. (AUTO  will use image and make it transparent black only.)
data.sections.graphics.image_shadow_fram: If shadow image should use frame animation of main image. .Alternative to AUTO_ANIMATED shadow value.
data.sections.graphics.image_shield: Image to show as a custom shield
data.sections.graphics.image_turret: Default image for all turrets, can also be set per turret
data.sections.graphics.image_wreak: Image to use when unit dies. Can be NONE to leave no wreak
data.sections.graphics.imagescale: Resize image. Defaults to 1. Effects leg, and shadow images as well.
data.sections.graphics.isvisible: If false will hide the unit.
data.sections.graphics.isvisibletoenemie: Only visible to player and allies when false. Recommend with showOnMinimapToEnemies. Useful for stealth units.
data.sections.graphics.lock_body_rotatio: Locks body image locked to the direction of the turret named "1" (turret_1) or the first turret defined (if a turret_1 is not defined)
data.sections.graphics.lock_leg_rotation: Locks legs and arms to the direction of the turret named "1" (turret_1) or the first turret defined (if a turret_1 is not defined)
data.sections.graphics.lock_shadow_rotat: Locks body image shadow locked to first turret's direction
data.sections.graphics.movementeffect: Custom movement effect, can be anything
data.sections.graphics.movementeffectrat: Sets the frequency of effects being spawned while moving
data.sections.graphics.movementeffectrev: Create effect as if unit has rotated 180 when reversing
data.sections.graphics.reclaimeffect: Custom reclaim effect, can be anything. Replaces default effect from builders
data.sections.graphics.reclaimeffectatta: Custom reclaim effect towards the reclaimed target
data.sections.graphics.reclaimeffectrate: Sets the frequency of effects being spawned while reclaiming. Defaults to 5, affects both sides.
data.sections.graphics.repaireffect: Custom repair effect, can be anything. Replaces default effect from builders
data.sections.graphics.repaireffectattar: Custom repair effect towards the repaired target
data.sections.graphics.repaireffectrate: Sets the frequency of effects being spawned while repairing. Defaults to 5, affects both sides.
data.sections.graphics.rotate_with_direc: Defaults to true. Makes unit body image locked to 0 degrees when false. Often used with animation_direction_*
data.sections.graphics.scaleimagesto: Resize image to fit this value in pixels.  Effects leg, and shadow images as well.

data.sections.graphics.showenergybar: Defaults to true. Shows the energy bar of a unit.
data.sections.graphics.showhealthbar: Defaults to true. Shows the health bar of a unit. (Still hidden even if true when "Always show unit health" setting is disabled.)
data.sections.graphics.showqueuebar: Defaults to true. Shows the bar for build or action queue of a unit.
data.sections.graphics.showselectionindi: Defaults to true. Shows select circle/box if true
data.sections.graphics.showshieldbar: Defaults to true. Shows the shield bar of a unit. Also affects the presence of set custom shield sprite.
data.sections.graphics.showshotdelaybar: Defaults to true. Shows the shot delay/warmup of a unit before firing.
data.sections.graphics.showtransportbar: Defaults to true. Shows the transport bar for transport units.
data.sections.graphics.splasteffect: True to create a water wave effect when over water. Default false
data.sections.graphics.splasteffectrever: True to also create effect when unit is reversing
data.sections.graphics.teamcoloringmode: How pixels are used for team coloring, options: pureGreen, hueAdd, hueShift, disabled
data.sections.graphics.teamcolorsonturre: Defaults false. Apply team colours on turret as well. Also effects pre-turret images
data.sections.graphics.teamcolorsusehue: False: Green pixels on unit gets converted to team color. True: Whole unit is tinted the team colour. Defaults to false
data.sections.graphics.whenbeingbuiltmak: How long the transparent effect is applied to incomplete units, set to 0 to disable completely. Default: 1
data.sections.hiddenAction: Actions that can do very wide range of things
data.sections.leg: Moveable cosmetics for mechs, infantry etc.
data.sections.leg_arm: Legs can move around when unit moves, Arms need an animation or convert
data.sections.leg_arm.x: Sets position of the foot on the X axis.
data.sections.leg_arm.y: Sets position of the foot on the Y axis.
data.sections.leg_arm.copyfrom: Copy from another leg. Useful to only need to set leg values once
data.sections.leg_arm.attach_x: Sets the leg's attach point on the X axis.

data.sections.leg_arm.enddiroffset: Target foot/end rotation relative to body

data.sections.leg_arm.heightspeed: Sets how fast the leg rises while walking
data.sections.leg_arm.movespeed: Sets how fast the leg moves while walking

data.sections.leg_arm.holddismin_checkne: Checks neighbors before applying distance holding

data.sections.leg_arm.image_end: Sets the main arm end sprite
data.sections.leg_arm.image_end_shadow: Sets the shadow for the arm
data.sections.leg_arm.image_end_teamcolo: When true, the arm end will apply team colors

data.sections.leg_arm.image_foot_shadow: Sets the shadow for the foot
data.sections.leg_arm.drawdiroffset: Rotates the foot/arm sprite to a specified direction
data.sections.leg_arm.dust_effect: Spawns dust particles on each step.
data.sections.leg_arm.spinrate: Makes arm/leg spin, like idleSpin for turrets. Great for helicopters
data.sections.leg_arm.favouroppositeside: calculate neighbours with X 10 times closer than Y
data.sections.leg_arm.drawlegwhenzoomedo: For performance, defaults changes based on unit size
data.sections.leg_arm.drawfootwhenzoomed: For performance, defaults changes based on unit size
data.sections.leg_arm.targetheightrelati: Apply height relative to unit's height
data.sections.logicBoolean: Advanced logic to place across all logic fields
data.sections.movement: These are traits the unit has as far as movement goes, such as rotation and acceleration speed

data.sections.movement.slowdeathfall: Used with large aircraft. Makes the unit fall slowly while maintaining its speed at the time of death.
data.sections.movement.movespeed: Maximum movement speed of the unit. A value of 1 means (1 pixel * 60) per second (or 3 tiles per second)
data.sections.movement.moveaccelerations: Defines how fast units accelerate to max speed.

data.sections.movement.landonground: Should flying unit land when idle.
data.sections.movement.targetheight: Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 35
data.sections.movement.targetheightdrift: Smooth animated height change. Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 1.5
data.sections.movement.startingheightoff: Sets the initial height on spawn. Defaults at 0.

data.sections.movement.fallingaccelerati: The acceleration in which a unit drops
data.sections.movement.maxturnspeed: Sets the top turning speed of a unit
data.sections.movement.turnacceleration: Defines how fast units accelerate to max turn speed.
data.sections.movement.moveslidingmode: Makes the unit slide when moveDecelerationSpeed is lower, making them drift and feel natural
data.sections.movement.moveignoringbody: Allows the unit to move without fully turning in the direction its moving, useful for ships and air units
data.sections.movement.joinsgroupformati: Defaults to true. Changing not recommended. When false, the unit will directly move to the assigned waypoint without taking space consideration from neighboring units.
data.sections.ai: This determines what the AI will use the unit for, does not effect player
data.sections.ai.useasbuilder: Set to true if unit can build or repair buildings. Defaults to [core]isBuilder.
data.sections.ai.useastransport: Defaults to true if unit can transport units
data.sections.ai.useasharvester: Defaults to true if unit can reclaim resources
data.sections.ai.disableuse: Disallow AI building this unit or building

data.sections.ai.maxglobal: Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per map

data.sections.ai.buildpriority: 0-1. AI uses 0.8 for first land factory, 0.48 for air factory, 0.47 for first turret.
data.sections.ai.noneinbaseextrapriority: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the AIs base
data.sections.ai.noneglobalextrapriority: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the any where on the map
data.sections.ai.recommendedineachbasepr: Defaults to 0.5. Overrides buildPriority if recommended in base is too low.
data.sections.ai.upgradedfrom: Create link to another unit to preserve max counts for upgraded and non-upgraded types in same base.
data.sections.ai.lowprioritytargetforoth: Useful for units that cannot attack back. Eg walls
data.sections.ai.whenusingasharvester_re: Assigns unit of the same name with certain amount on an AI base
Assigns unit of the same name with certain amount on map
data.sections.ai.whenusingasharvester_in: Includes all harvester types on a single counter
data.sections.ai.onlyuseasharvester_ifba: Only sets the harvester unit as a harvester if an AI base has a unit with particular tag(s)
data.sections.placementRule: Allows creation of rules for buildings
data.sections.prices: Useable resources for prices using "price:" function
data.sections.projectile: Projectiles are often used to inflict damage on an enemy, but can also be used for other purposes
data.sections.projectile.life: How long till this projectile gets removed if it hasn't hit a target, 300 might be a good starting point, change depending on speed and range
data.sections.projectile.deflectionpower: Defaults to 1. Energy needed for laser defence to deflect. -1 to disable deflection (only disable for special weapons like flames)
data.sections.projectile.explodeonendofl: Default to false. True to explode at end of life with all side effects and area damage instead of disappearing. Good for making area-denial weapons.
data.sections.projectile.autotargetingon: Retarget to nearby unit if target dies while in transit
The range which it will select a new target if old target has died
The lead it will try to have on the new target
data.sections.projectile.unloaduptoxunit: Unload X units from source unit, to projectile explode location
data.sections.projectile.teleportsource: Move unit that shot this projectile to projectile explode location
data.sections.projectile.spawnunit: Spawn new units of this type at projectile explode location
data.sections.projectile.spawnprojectile: Spawns new projectiles on end of life, useful for secondary projectiles
Projectiles to spawns when this projectile hits it's target
Spawns projectiles on creation of this projectile, useful for making true shotgun-like projectile spread
data.sections.projectile.converthittosou: Convert units hit to the team that fired this projectile. Useful to make capturing systems
data.sections.projectile.tags: Used for projectile interceptions  (e.g. Nuke and Anti-Nuke Interaction) and in [action] autoTriggerOnEvent: tookDamage(withTag="[tagName]")
data.sections.projectile.flameweapon: Generates small flames on hit (only cosmetic)
data.sections.projectile.delayedstarttim: Hide for x time before showing and updating effect.
data.sections.projectile.directdamage: Damage to target unit on hit. Does not work with targetGround:true as it won't have a clear unit to target
data.sections.projectile.areadamage: Damages on arrival of target with an area effect, use areaRadius to adjust size of damage. targetGround needs this to damage
data.sections.projectile.arearadius: How wide areaDamage effects. Note this drops off (unless areaDamageNoFalloff is used)
data.sections.projectile.arearadiusfrome: Applies damage from edge of units instead of center. Mostly effects large units.
data.sections.projectile.areaexpandtime: Applies area damage as an expanding blast wave rather than instantly. Useful for nuke projectiles
data.sections.projectile.areaignoreunits: Units closer than this range aren't effected. Rarely needed. Not recommended for normal projectiles.
data.sections.projectile.shielddamagemul: Defaults to 1.  0 to do no damage to shields and 2 to do double damage
data.sections.projectile.shielddefection: Defaults to 1. The amount of shield to bypass. 0 to ignore shields and directly damage hull
data.sections.projectile.hulldamagemulti: Defaults to 1. Can be used to create EMP weapons that affect shields only. 0 to ignore hull and only damage shields
data.sections.projectile.ignoreparentsho: Sets whether multipliers are applied or not regardless of multipliers set in attack or setUnitStats
data.sections.projectile.armourignoreamo: Amount of armour to ignore on target and do damage as if this armour was not there
data.sections.projectile.friendlyfire: Lets area effect projectiles damage own team units (can't damage allies). Useful for nuke-like weapons
data.sections.projectile.mutatorx_ifunit: Applies mutators to this projectile if target has corresponding tags
Same as ifUnitWithTags, but applies if target doesn't have the set tags
data.sections.projectile.mutatorx_direct: Changes directDamage. Defaults to 1. Be careful not to confuse players using this as the effect may not be clear. Use amour instead when possible. Replace X with desired name
data.sections.projectile.mutatorx_areada: Same as directDamageMultiplier but for areaDamage. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.projectile.mutatorx_change: Change explode effect if this mutator is active. Eg make a bounce off amour effect. Helps to make the damage change more clear to players (Doesn't work with targetGround.)
data.sections.projectile.mutatorx_addres: Add resource to all direct hit units. Warning: Be careful not be break units from other mods by adding random resources or energy to them that they don't expect.
Add resource to all area hit units. Warning: Be careful not be break units from other mods by adding random resources or energy to them that they don't expect.
data.sections.projectile.targetground: Target ground, and don't home in on target. Note: only areaDamage is applied if targeting ground.
data.sections.projectile.targetground_in: Default false. for area affect AA weapons
data.sections.projectile.targetgroundhei: Default 0. for shooting over or under a target. Useful for projectiles that split and rain down.
data.sections.projectile.targetspeedacce: Controls the speed rampup for targetSpeed
data.sections.projectile.ballistic: Makes projectiles fly up into the air and come down, instead of going in a straight line
data.sections.projectile.ballistic_delay: Sets up to how high the projectile needs to be before moving normally
data.sections.projectile.ballistic_heigh: Sets the target height of the projectile
data.sections.projectile.targetgroundspr: Randomly makes the shot inaccurate by this amount. Also used by weapons like the flamethrower
data.sections.projectile.speedspread: Randomly change the starting projectile speed by this amount
data.sections.projectile.instantreuselas: Recycles last projectile fired, only one projectile ever exists. Can turn lasers into beam weapons by using lower rate of fire and setting this to true
Make turret's aim include last projectile's spread and sweep offsets, useful for beam weapons
Default false. Keeping the list was the normal behaviour in 1.13 making area damage not apply a second time but this is not useful. Use this only if you want the old behaviour.
data.sections.projectile.interceptprojec: Defaults to false. When false projectiles are just removed. Could be true to make hit projectiles explode or split when hit
data.sections.projectile.disableleadtarg: Disable the lead targeting calculations when aiming at a moving target. Defaults false.
data.sections.projectile.leadtargetingsp: The expected speed of this projectile for targetGround lead target calculation. Defaults to 'targetSpeed' if set otherwise 'speed'.
data.sections.projectile.initialunguided: Sets vertical speed for projectiles with targetGround. Use gravity to make smooth arching projectiles. Better have gravity value slightly slower than this key to produce the arches.
data.sections.projectile.gravity: Controls the pull for projectiles that target ground. Use together with initialUnguidedSpeedHeight
data.sections.projectile.turnspeed: Limits the turn speed of a projectile, making them inaccurate even with directDamage. Zero value will make it act like if targetGround is set true, but air target friendly option.
data.sections.projectile.wobbleamplitude: How wide the projectile will wobble
data.sections.projectile.wobblefrequency: How often the projectile will wobble
data.sections.projectile.pushforce: Push (or pull with a negative value) the units that get hit. Divided by target mass
data.sections.projectile.pushvelocity: Push (or pull with a negative value) the units that get hit. Ignores target mass
data.sections.projectile.movewithparent: Move projectile as parent moves. Useful for beam effects that need to stick to source turret.
data.sections.projectile.sweepoffsetfrom: Add to sweep offset by factor of target's radius. 0.4 would be 40%
data.sections.projectile.retargetinginfl: Can retarget a new target mid-flight, perfect for flak-style weapons and projectiles that collide
How long between searching for new targets. Default 5
Range which targets are reselected. Default 120
The lead of the projectile to try to hit the target. Default 15
Only retarget units with these tags

data.sections.projectile.image: Use custom image. Overrides drawType and frame

data.sections.projectile.traileffect: true for built-in defaults, but can also point to any custom effects

data.sections.projectile.largehiteffect: Creates a large explosion and accompanying sound on hit (only cosmetic)

data.sections.projectile.lasereffect: Draw as laser works best with instant:true

data.sections.projectile.beamimagestart: Sprite for the origin point of the custom beam
data.sections.projectile.beamimagestartr: Defaults false. True to rotate with turret angle
data.sections.projectile.beamimageend: Sprite for the end point of the custom beam
data.sections.resource: Local resource used by units can be used for ammo
data.sections.spawnProjectiles: Lists you can form for spawning projectiles
data.sections.spawnUnits: Lists you can form for spawning units
data.sections.template: Used to create sections that can be referenced in unit
data.sections.turret: Turrets fire projectiles with different traits
data.sections.turret.aimoffsetspread: Sets the shot inaccuracy. 0 will make all shots land on target's center
data.sections.turret.altprojectile: Alternative projectile fired from this turret when altProjectileCondition is true
data.sections.turret.attachedto: A specific turret to connect to, it will rotate with it. No correlation to [attachment_x]
data.sections.turret.barrelheight: Height of barrel in 3d. Effect projectile and shoot flame starting height
data.sections.turret.barrelx: Defaults to 0. Controls horizontal position for projectile spawn.
data.sections.turret.barrely: Defaults to size. Note: size and barrelY have the same meaning
data.sections.turret.barreloffsetx_onodd: 0 by default. Sets a barrelX offset only during odd numbered shots, useful for twin-barreled units. Use with barrelX. Use the opposite value of barrelX for most cases.
data.sections.turret.canattackcondition: Normally, used to optionally disable a turret based on a LogicBoolean. Eg: this unit's height
data.sections.turret.canattackflyingunit: Narrows targeting for this turret, note targeting for the whole unit in [attack] is applied first. (so you can only use this to target less not more)
data.sections.turret.canattacklandunits: Default true. If false unit cannot attack surface units.
data.sections.turret.canattackmaxangle: Max angle to target for turret to be allowed for fire. Defaults to 5, don't set lower. Can be set to 181 for turrets that don't need to turn to fire missiles.
data.sections.turret.canattacknottouchin: Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos.
data.sections.turret.canattackunderwater: Default true. If false unit cannot attack underwaterunits.
data.sections.turret.canonlyattackunitsw: Only attacks potential targets with specific tags
Only attacks potential targets without specific tags
data.sections.turret.canattackmaxangle: Max angle to target for turret to be allowed for fire. Defaults to 5, don't set lower. Can be set to 181 for turrets that don't need to turn to fire missiles.
data.sections.turret.canattacknottouchin: Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos.
data.sections.turret.canattackunderwater: Default true. If false unit cannot attack underwaterunits.
data.sections.turret.canonlyattackunitsw: Only attacks potential targets with specific tags
Only attacks potential targets without specific tags
data.sections.turret.chargeeffectimage: Used with warmup. Shows a scaling effect image on turret barrel when charging.
data.sections.turret.clearTurrettargetaf: Clears the turrets sub-target when using multi-targeting
data.sections.turret.copyfrom: Copy all values from another turret as defaut values for this turret
data.sections.turret.delay: Override global shootDelay for this turret
data.sections.turret.energyusage: Required energy to fire weapon. Same as resourceUsage: energy=X
data.sections.turret.height: Height of the unit in 3D, to be used with decals
data.sections.turret.idledirreversing: Defaults to idleDir+180 unless attached to another turret (as attached turret will often be rotating when reversing)
data.sections.turret.idlespin: Spin rate when idle, used on missile turrets
data.sections.turret.idlesweepaddrandomd: Default 1-20 depends on idleSweepDelay, used to stop sweep syncing up with other units
data.sections.turret.idlesweepangle: Disabled by default. Controls how far the turret will "look" left and right
data.sections.turret.idlesweepdelay: Controls the delay between idleSweep movements
data.sections.turret.idlesweepspeed: Controls the speed with which the turret sweeps when idle
data.sections.turret.image: Use custom image. Overrides unit's main turret image
data.sections.turret.image_applyteamcolo: When true, the specific turret applies team colors over the special greens in the sprite.
data.sections.turret.image_drawoffsetx: Moves the image horizontally from the turret center.
data.sections.turret.image_drawoffsety: Moves the image verticallly from the turret center.
data.sections.turret.interceptprojectile: Defaults to 0. Sets the projectile target height limit
Minimum distance required for intercepting projectile
Defaults to 2000, distance inflight before firing
data.sections.turret.invisible: Don't render this turret, but still can shoot, etc.
data.sections.turret.ismainnanoturret: Defaults to false. Turret to use for creating buildings, etc. should only be true on one turret, and should have canShoot set to false
data.sections.turret.laserdefenceenergyu: Set to enable a projectile laser defence from this turret. Should also set the energyMax in core.
data.sections.turret.limitingangle: Linked with idleDir. Turret will only be able to fire at units +/- this angle.
data.sections.turret.limitingrange: Make this turret have less range than the maxAttackRange. Do not apply this to all turrets change maxAttackRange instead.
data.sections.turret.linkdelaywithturret: When this other turret fires the cooldown delay on this turret will be reset/removed
data.sections.turret.onshoot_playanimati: Play a custom animation from an [animation] section after firing this turret
data.sections.turret.onshoot_triggeracti: Trigger these actions each time this turret fires
data.sections.turret.recoilooffset: Push turret forward or back after firing for a recoil effect. Value in pixels.
data.sections.turret.recoilouttime: Time to get to offset position after firing
data.sections.turret.recoilreturntime: Time to return to default position
data.sections.turret.resourceusage: can be in credits/energy/hp/shield/ammo. Stops firing if not met
data.sections.turret.showrangeuiguide: Defaults to true. Displays the attack range for this turret
data.sections.turret.shouldresetturret: Defaults true. False to disable the reseting turret angle when idle
data.sections.turret.size: Controls the distance between the center of the turret and the point from where projectiles spawn.
data.sections.turret.slave: Locks this turret's direction and shot cooldown to attached turret. Often used with warmup for multiple barrel guns
data.sections.turret.shoot_flame: Current types are: small, large, smoke, shockwave, or CUSTOM: effectSectionName
data.sections.turret.shoot_light: Produces a colored light upon shooting
data.sections.turret.shoot_sound: Can be linked to an .ogg or .wav file, or one of the default game sounds (list at bottom of reference)
data.sections.turret.shoot_sound_vol: Sets the volume of the shoot sound
data.sections.turret.turnspeed: Max turn speed of the turret
data.sections.turret.turnspeedaccelerati: Defaults to disabled, and full turn speed is used.
data.sections.turret.turnspeeddecelerati: Defaults to turnSpeedAcceleration. Setting this higher than turn acceleration might allow faster targets to be hit
data.sections.turret.unloaduptoxunitsand: Unloads X units at turret barrel locations and gives them the attack order of turret target
data.sections.turret.warmupcalldownrate: Rate to reduce warmup when turret is not ready to fire at any targets
data.sections.turret.warmupnoreset: Defaults to false. When true warmup is not reset after firing a shot and turret doesn't wait for warmup. Used with warmupCallDownRate and warmupShootDelayTransfer.
data.sections.turret.warmupshootdelaytra: Defaults to 0, amount to reduces the next shot delay depending on warmup. When used with warmupNoReset, can make a each shot faster.
data.sections.turret.warmupstarteffect: Spawns specified effects when the specific turret is charging/warming up
data.sections.turret.x: Sets the horizontal position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward left, positives toward right.
data.sections.turret.y: Sets the vertical position of the turret.  0 is center, negatives toward bottom, positives toward top.
